## Why This Is Asked
This question tests real-world Azure data pipelines with hybrid sources, schema drift, incremental loads, and lineage, aligning with roles at Snowflake, DoorDash, and Lyft.

## Key Concepts
- Ingest from on-prem Kafka to ADLS Gen2 with incremental offsets
- Delta Lake SCD Type 2 and schema evolution
- Star schema design in Azure Synapse
- End-to-end data lineage with Purview across hybrid estate
- Secure, scalable access via managed identities and RBAC

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo-Spark-like pseudocode for incremental load and SCD2 merge
val source = spark.read.format("parquet").load("abfss://landing@storage.dfs.core.windows.net/events/")
val target = spark.read.table("analytics.star_fact")
val merged = target.alias("t").merge(
  source.alias("s"), "t.id = s.id"
).whenMatchedUpdate(set = mapFromColumns("t", "s"))
  .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
```
